name: com.gossip.core
description:
OpenXR-first Unity SDK for XR analytics, capturing high-signal spatial telemetry from immersive experiences and turning it into AI-driven decisions. Tracks session lifecycle, user/device context, movement, eye/hand signals, interactions and immersive metrics in real time, with minimal performance impact.

Built around a component-based tracker architecture, the SDK ships with 4 next-gen spatial heatmaps (owl view, human view, eye view and Hand&Controller) that adapt to static, procedural and swappable environments. Supports Dev, Beta and Production environments natively, keeping production data clean and isolated with 2-click switching.

samples.description: Import this to finish setting up the SDK. Once imported, go to Window → Gossip Analytics → Quick Setup — one click adds the manager to your scene, assigns your settings, and you're ready. Then enter your API Key and press Play.

- Gossip.cs: EyeTrackingTracker and InputUsageTracker were missing from the RunResendLoopAsync resend worker list. Both trackers now share the same automatic retry resilience as all other trackers.
